body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

**Testing project:** [test_dds_cubemap.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17545637/test_dds_cubemap.zip)

### Before

*Notice the resource type icon at the top. Here, it's loaded as a Texture2D. Only one face is imported.*

Uncompressed | DXT5
-|-
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd077528-e2ca-41cd-b342-e3382970c2b0) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/893bee39-699a-406f-bc28-a0d32b96087c)

### After

*The DDS file is now loaded as a Cubemap automatically. Memory usage is multiplied by 6 because it's now importing all faces, not just one.*

Uncompressed | DXT5
-|-
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3674a1c5-9e75-4f59-82c4-bf39723569c8) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/664ed810-404b-465f-9dea-0321dfcc3b54)

PS: We should improve the Cubemap preview to allow choosing a face to view, or even have an interactive view like the material preview (except you'd be *inside* the box and the box would be unshaded, and with flipped faces).
